ChatGPT said:

Yes — I found the likely culprit, and I can fix it.

The app itself is loading correctly at your GitHub Pages URL. usmannizam84.github.io

What is going wrong

The problem is the way V1 was adding the yellow/red/green conditional formatting to the review workbook.

The app uses ExcelJS to read the existing Excel workbook and then writes it back out. ExcelJS does support conditional formatting, but there are known cases where rewriting an existing workbook with conditional-formatting information can result in Excel reporting that the file is damaged and repairing/removing worksheet information. GitHub+1

That explains your two symptoms happening together:

  • Excel says the downloaded review file has an error.

  • The J–M cells that the app generated appear blank after Excel repairs/opens the workbook.

I changed the approach

I've made a fixed version that:

  • still calculates J, K, L and M

  • still calculates the difference

  • still gives you:

    • 🟨 yellow = online price too high

    • 🟥 red = online price too low

    • 🟩 green = same

  • does not use ExcelJS conditional-formatting XML

  • instead applies the appropriate cell colour directly to column M

Visually, you'll get the same result, but this avoids the part of the workbook-writing process that's most likely causing the Excel repair problem.

Download the fixed version

Or, if you'd rather use the ZIP:

What to do in GitHub

Since your existing repository is already working:

  1. Download the fixed index.html above.

  2. Go to your iqbal-produce-price-updater repository.

  3. Click Add file → Upload files.

  4. Upload the new index.html.

  5. GitHub should recognize that an index.html already exists.

  6. Replace/overwrite the existing file.

  7. Commit directly to main.

  8. Wait about a minute for GitHub Pages to redeploy.

  9. Open your app again.

You do not need to create another repository.

One more thing I noticed

I also checked the actual Excel files you previously supplied. Their structure matches the app's intended locations: the retail file has Article code in A and RSP in H, while the online file has the online price in F and the ERP identifier in the specified area. So I don't think the underlying Excel files are the main problem.

I'd test this fixed version with your same two files first. If the review workbook opens normally and J–M are populated, we've nailed the issue. Then we can tackle V2 improvements without risking the working price-calculation logic.

<style>
  :root { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; color: #222; background:#f5f7f9; }

<body>
<div class="wrap">
  <h1>Iqbal Foods – Weekly Produce Price Updater</h1>
  <p class="sub">Match ERP codes, calculate +25% from RSP, apply the X.X9 rounding rule, compare against online prices, and create both upload and review files.</p>

  <div class="card">
    <div class="grid">
      <div>
        <label for="retailFile">1. Weekly Produce Retail Price File</label>
        <input id="retailFile" type="file" accept=".xlsx">
        <div class="hint">ERP code = column A. RSP = column H. The weekly file should contain the normal retail columns A–I; J–M are generated by this app.</div>

      <div>
        <label for="onlineFile">2. Online Produce Price Update File</label>
        <input id="onlineFile" type="file" accept=".xlsx">

      </div>

    <div class="actions">
      <button id="processBtn" class="primary" disabled>Process Files</button>
      <button id="clearBtn" class="secondary">Clear</button>

      <div id="conflictList" class="hint"></div>

      The Excel files are read and processed locally in your browser using JavaScript.
      No Excel data is sent to GitHub or to a processing server. GitHub Pages only hosts this webpage and its JavaScript library.
    </div>
    <div class="hint" style="margin-top:8px">
      Matching is done by ERP code only. All online rows with a matching ERP code are updated. Nothing else in the online workbook is intentionally changed.
    </div>

<script>
const retailInput = document.getElementById('retailFile');
const onlineInput = document.getElementById('onlineFile');
const processBtn = document.getElementById('processBtn');
const clearBtn = document.getElementById('clearBtn');
const statusBox = document.getElementById('status');
const resultsCard = document.getElementById('resultsCard');
const downloadUpload = document.getElementById('downloadUpload');
const downloadReview = document.getElementById('downloadReview');

let uploadBuffer = null;
let reviewBuffer = null;
let uploadName = '';
let reviewName = '';

function filesReady() {
  processBtn.disabled = !(retailInput.files.length && onlineInput.files.length);
}
retailInput.addEventListener('change', filesReady);
onlineInput.addEventListener('change', filesReady);

function money(v) {
  return Number.isFinite(v) ? Number(v.toFixed(2)) : null;
}

// Rounding rule:
// X.X5–X.X8 -> X.X9
// X.X0–X.X4 -> X.X9
// X.X9      -> X.X9
function roundToX9(value) {
  const x = money(value);
  if (x === null) return null;
  const centsDigit = Math.round(x * 100) % 10;
  if (centsDigit === 9) return x;
  const baseTenth = Math.floor((x + 1e-9) * 10) / 10;
  if (centsDigit <= 4) return money(baseTenth - 0.01);
  return money(baseTenth + 0.09);
}

function findHeaderRow(ws, requiredNames) {
  for (let r = 1; r <= Math.min(ws.rowCount, 30); r++) {
    const vals = [];
    for (let c = 1; c <= ws.columnCount; c++) {
      vals.push(String(ws.getCell(r,c).value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase());
    }
    if (requiredNames.every(n => vals.includes(n.toLowerCase()))) return r;
  }
  return null;
}

function numericValue(v) {
  if (typeof v === 'number') return v;
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return null;
  const n = Number(String(v).replace(/[$,]/g,'').trim());
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
}

function excelCellText(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return '';
  if (v instanceof Date) return v.toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
  if (typeof v === 'object' && v.text !== undefined) return String(v.text);
  return String(v);
}

function copyCellStyle(src, dst) {
  if (src.hasStyle) {
    dst.style = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(src.style));
  }
  if (src.numFmt) dst.numFmt = src.numFmt;
  if (src.alignment) dst.alignment = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(src.alignment));
  if (src.protection) dst.protection = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(src.protection));
}

function setStatus(text, cls='') {
  statusBox.className = 'status ' + cls;
  statusBox.textContent = text;
}

function todayDate() {
  const d = new Date();
  return new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());
}

function dateFileStamp() {
  const d = new Date();
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
}

function downloadBuffer(buffer, filename) {
  const blob = new Blob([buffer], {
    type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
  });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

processBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
  resultsCard.hidden = true;
  uploadBuffer = reviewBuffer = null;

  try {
    processBtn.disabled = true;
    setStatus('Reading both Excel files locally in your browser…');

    const retailArray = await retailInput.files[0].arrayBuffer();
    const onlineArray = await onlineInput.files[0].arrayBuffer();

    const retailWb = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
    const onlineWb = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
    await retailWb.xlsx.load(retailArray);
    await onlineWb.xlsx.load(onlineArray);

    const retailWs = retailWb.worksheets[0];
    const onlineWs = onlineWb.worksheets[0];

    const retailHeader = findHeaderRow(retailWs, ['Article code', 'RSP']);
    const onlineHeader = findHeaderRow(onlineWs, ['Product ID', 'Price']);

    if (!retailHeader) throw new Error('Could not find the retail file header row containing "Article code" and "RSP".');
    if (!onlineHeader) throw new Error('Could not find the online file header row containing "Product ID" and "Price".');

    // User-defined fixed locations:
    // Retail ERP code = A, RSP = H
    // Online ERP code = P, price = F, discount = H, discount start = I
    const retailDataStart = retailHeader + 1;
    const onlineDataStart = onlineHeader + 1;

    // Build retail calculation map. Duplicate ERP rows are allowed.
    const retailRows = [];
    const retailByCode = new Map();

    for (let r = retailDataStart; r <= retailWs.rowCount; r++) {
      const code = numericValue(retailWs.getCell(r, 1).value);
      const rsp = numericValue(retailWs.getCell(r, 8).value);
      if (code === null) continue;
      if (rsp === null) continue;

      const plus25 = money(rsp * 1.25);
      const rounded = roundToX9(plus25);
      const entry = { row:r, code, rsp, plus25, rounded };
      retailRows.push(entry);
      if (!retailByCode.has(code)) retailByCode.set(code, []);
      retailByCode.get(code).push(entry);
    }

    // Detect conflicting calculations for the same ERP code.
    const conflicts = [];
    for (const [code, arr] of retailByCode.entries()) {
      const targets = [...new Set(arr.map(x => x.rounded))];
      if (targets.length > 1) conflicts.push({code, targets});
    }

    // Prepare review columns J-M in the retail workbook.
    const headers = ['1.25', 'round', 'ecomm now', 'diff'];
    for (let i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
      const c = 10 + i;
      const src = retailWs.getCell(retailHeader, Math.min(c, retailWs.columnCount));
      const dst = retailWs.getCell(retailHeader, c);
      dst.value = headers[i];
      if (src && src.hasStyle) copyCellStyle(src, dst);
    }

    // Use simple numeric formats for calculation columns.
    for (let r = retailDataStart; r <= retailWs.rowCount; r++) {
      retailWs.getCell(r, 10).numFmt = '0.00';
      retailWs.getCell(r, 11).numFmt = '0.00';
      retailWs.getCell(r, 12).numFmt = '0.00';
      retailWs.getCell(r, 13).numFmt = '0.00';
    }

    // Clear old J-M values before populating the new review.
    for (let r = retailDataStart; r <= retailWs.rowCount; r++) {
      for (let c = 10; c <= 13; c++) retailWs.getCell(r,c).value = null;
    }

    // Build online lookup: ERP code in P. Multiple online rows with same code are all updated.
    const onlineByCode = new Map();
    for (let r = onlineDataStart; r <= onlineWs.rowCount; r++) {
      const code = numericValue(onlineWs.getCell(r, 16).value);
      if (code === null) continue;
      if (!onlineByCode.has(code)) onlineByCode.set(code, []);
      onlineByCode.get(code).push(r);
    }

    let matched = 0, changed = 0, same = 0, missing = 0;
    let discountRows = 0, discountChanged = 0;
    const missingCodes = [];
    const discountNotes = [];
    const conflictCodes = new Set(conflicts.map(x => x.code));

    // For each retail row, show the first matching online price, mirroring XLOOKUP behavior.
    for (const entry of retailRows) {
      const onlineRows = onlineByCode.get(entry.code) || [];
      retailWs.getCell(entry.row, 10).value = entry.plus25;
      retailWs.getCell(entry.row, 11).value = entry.rounded;

      if (!onlineRows.length) {
        retailWs.getCell(entry.row, 12).value = null;
        retailWs.getCell(entry.row, 13).value = null;
        continue;
      }

      const firstOnlineRow = onlineRows[0];
      const currentPrice = numericValue(onlineWs.getCell(firstOnlineRow, 6).value);
      if (currentPrice === null) {
        retailWs.getCell(entry.row, 12).value = null;
        retailWs.getCell(entry.row, 13).value = null;
        continue;
      }

      retailWs.getCell(entry.row, 12).value = currentPrice;
      retailWs.getCell(entry.row, 13).value = money(entry.rounded - currentPrice);
    }

    // Apply review colours directly to the Difference cells.
    // We intentionally use ordinary cell fills instead of ExcelJS conditional-
    // formatting XML. This avoids Excel repair errors that can occur when an
    // existing workbook is rewritten with conditional-formatting rules.
    for (const entry of retailRows) {
      const diffCell = retailWs.getCell(entry.row, 13);
      const diff = numericValue(diffCell.value);

      if (diff === null) {
        diffCell.fill = {
          type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }
        };
      } else if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.000001) {
        // Same = green
        diffCell.fill = {
          type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FFD9EAD3' }
        };
      } else if (diff < 0) {
        // Online price too high = yellow
        diffCell.fill = {
          type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FFFFF2CC' }
        };
      } else {
        // Online price too low = red
        diffCell.fill = {
          type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FFFFCCCC' }
        };
      }
    }

    // Apply updates to the online workbook.
    const today = todayDate();

    for (const [code, rows] of onlineByCode.entries()) {
      const retailEntries = retailByCode.get(code);
      if (!retailEntries || conflictCodes.has(code)) continue;

      // Normally all duplicate retail rows have the same target. Use that target.
      const target = retailEntries[0].rounded;

      for (const r of rows) {
        const priceCell = onlineWs.getCell(r, 6);
        const discountCell = onlineWs.getCell(r, 8);
        const startCell = onlineWs.getCell(r, 9);

        const oldPrice = numericValue(priceCell.value);
        if (oldPrice === null) continue;

        const oldDiscount = numericValue(discountCell.value);
        const hasDiscount = oldDiscount !== null && oldDiscount > 0;

        if (Math.abs(target - oldPrice) < 0.000001) {
          same++;
        } else {
          priceCell.value = target;
          priceCell.numFmt = oldPrice % 1 === 0 ? '0.00' : priceCell.numFmt;
          changed++;
        }
        matched++;

        if (hasDiscount) {
          discountRows++;
          const salePrice = money(oldPrice - oldDiscount);
          const newDiscount = money(target - salePrice);

          if (newDiscount < 0) {
            // A valid positive discount cannot preserve a sale price above the new regular price.
            // Leave discount untouched and flag it for review rather than creating an invalid negative discount.
            discountNotes.push(`ERP ${code}, online row ${r}: target ${target.toFixed(2)} is below existing sale price ${salePrice.toFixed(2)}; discount was left unchanged.`);
          } else {
            if (Math.abs(newDiscount - oldDiscount) > 0.000001) {
              discountCell.value = newDiscount;
              discountChanged++;
            }
            startCell.value = today;
            startCell.numFmt = 'mm/dd/yyyy';
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Missing codes = unique ERP codes in retail with no online row.
    for (const code of retailByCode.keys()) {
      if (!onlineByCode.has(code)) {
        missing++;
        missingCodes.push(code);
      }
    }

    // Create the two downloadable workbooks.
    reviewBuffer = await retailWb.xlsx.writeBuffer();
    uploadBuffer = await onlineWb.xlsx.writeBuffer();

    const stamp = dateFileStamp();
    reviewName = `Produce Price Review ${stamp}.xlsx`;
    uploadName = `Produce Price Update Upload ${stamp}.xlsx`;

    document.getElementById('matched').textContent = matched;
    document.getElementById('changed').textContent = changed;
    document.getElementById('same').textContent = same;
    document.getElementById('missing').textContent = missing;

    const missingDetails = document.getElementById('missingDetails');
    if (missingCodes.length) {
      missingDetails.hidden = false;
      document.getElementById('missingList').textContent = [...new Set(missingCodes)].join(', ');
    } else {
      missingDetails.hidden = true;
    }

    const conflictDetails = document.getElementById('conflictDetails');
    if (conflicts.length) {
      conflictDetails.hidden = false;
      document.getElementById('conflictList').innerHTML =
        conflicts.map(x => `ERP <b>${x.code}</b>: calculated prices = ${x.targets.map(v => Number(v).toFixed(2)).join(', ')}. Those online rows were not changed.`).join('<br>');
    } else {
      conflictDetails.hidden = true;
    }

    const discountDetails = document.getElementById('discountDetails');
    if (discountRows || discountNotes.length) {
      discountDetails.hidden = false;
      document.getElementById('discountList').innerHTML =
        `${discountRows} matched online row(s) had an existing discount; ${discountChanged} discount value(s) were adjusted to preserve the existing sale price. Discount start dates were reset to today for valid discounted rows.` +
        (discountNotes.length ? `<br><br><b>Manual review:</b><br>${discountNotes.join('<br>')}` : '');
    } else {
      discountDetails.hidden = true;
    }

    resultsCard.hidden = false;
    setStatus(
      `Done. Calculations were performed locally in your browser.\n` +
      `Bulk upload file and review file are ready to download.\n` +
      `Current date used for discounted items: ${String(today.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}/${String(today.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}/${today.getFullYear()}.`,
      missingCodes.length || conflicts.length || discountNotes.length ? 'warn' : 'success'
    );

  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    setStatus('Error: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err)), 'error');
  } finally {
    processBtn.disabled = false;
  }
});

downloadUpload.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (uploadBuffer) downloadBuffer(uploadBuffer, uploadName);
});
